text.text_excerpt: In the context of dive bars, this place is a hidden gem. Where this place excels and makes it one of best damn bars in NOLA is the people. I felt a sense of comfort and community at this place. Every one is welcoming and seem like it's the spot where locals go to unwind and have a few drinks. They have an awesome touch screen juke box that you can pretty much play anything on, some card game slot machines, an old school cigarette dispenser, and a coin operated breathalyzer on the wall so you can see how trashed you really are. If you don't mind a run down bathroom, a mellow atmosphere and nostalgic vibe, then pull up a barstool and have a few drinks at Chuck's--open damn near 24 hours.
What an interesting little dive bar! We just popped in and out as part of a pub crawl but will definitely visit again! Great cheap drinks!

Chuck's is indeed a true dive bar. One of my many favorite places in New Orleans... It's only closed for about 15 minutes while they change out the slot machines... We are having our first pit stop at Chuck's Wed 2/ 29 before the rockboat... Cannot wait!!! Stiff drinks and sketchy clientele. LOVE it!
